sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Post-holiday tech stocks rebounded across the board, with Nasdaq leading: As of 12:08 ET (past the halfway point intraday), QQQ was at 725.55 (+1.83%) leading the gains, SPY was at 750.91 (+0.81%) just stepping above the 750 level, IWM at 300.33 (+0.94%), while DIA at 527.83 (nearly flat, pulling back after touching a 52-week high intraday) clearly lagged—a textbook case of growth outperforming value.
  • AMD surged on no news, leading chip stocks: AMD gained +9.01% on the day to 564.93, becoming the market’s center of attention; together with SMH opening +2.7% and Intel up +3% premarket, the chip sector extended a strong repair rally after last week’s divergence. AVGO +3.93%, MRVL +4.46%. NVDA was only +1.04%, stuck at 196, once again reduced to a laughingstock as a “boomer stock.”
  • Memory stocks were highly volatile, with the whole market holding its breath for Samsung: MU seesawed violently in the 989–1019 range, now +3.63% at 1010, repeatedly breaking above and below the 1000 level; SNDK +3.81%, WDC strengthened. Samsung will release its Q2 preliminary earnings on 7/7, with the market expecting operating profit of about 85.5 trillion won (about $55.9 billion), up roughly 18x YoY. DRAM/NAND contract prices rose 40–65% QoQ, seen as the next catalyst that will decide the memory bulls vs bears battle.
  • Trump Accounts rang the opening bell: Trump rang the opening bell for Nasdaq/NYSE from the White House Oval Office, marking the first trading day for children’s investment accounts; about 6 million people have already registered, Michael/Susan Dell pledged $6.25 billion, and SpaceX’s Shotwell gifted shares to 2 million children. DELL stock +7.55%.
  • TSLA broke out, +6.10% to 416.8: Robotaxi service expansion to Miami, combined with last quarter’s better-than-expected deliveries, reignited the autonomous-driving narrative, with the community screaming “420 EOD.”
  • RDDT +5.68% to 205.84 on no news (up +32% over the past 5 days), becoming the new favorite for capital outside semiconductors; HOOD +4.64%, IREN +15%.
  • MSFT sank alone: -1.10% to 385, announced another 4,800 job cuts (including 3,200 at Xbox), YTD -20%, the only large-cap tech stock falling against the broader uptrend.
  • Rate alarm: The 30-year Treasury yield returned to 5%, the 20-year broke 5%, sparking community concerns over fiscal issues/inflation.

社区气氛：总体来说，这是一盘“牛市狂欢但心情烦躁”的分盘——SPY收复750，筹码大幅上涨，让多头再次嘲讽空头“屡次被困被杀”，但极低的成交量缓慢熔升却让大家抱怨波动性不足，theta吃掉期权。大量空头在节后购买看跌期权后集体死亡，愤世嫉俗的兴奋情绪蔓延：“我们知道它被操纵，但我们只能接受它。”

恐惧/贪婪：贪婪倾向（约70/100）。 VIX回落至13-15，看跌/看涨比一度飙升至2，多头占据压倒性优势，但底下却是“见顶已近/地毯拉扯即将到来”的焦虑。社区情绪与实际走势：社区不断抱怨低波动性，许多人大喊“地毯”和“红色日子”，而实际主要指数却稳步攀升——情绪明显滞后并低估了当天的涨幅。
